# AMC Graphite

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · dark · built on vita-dark · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A developer and operations console look: neutral charcoal surfaces, warm-grey text, an amber primary, hairline borders and monospaced tabular figures for numbers, report headings and badges.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_graphite.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-graphite.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-graphite.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-graphite` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Dark style built on Vita Dark. Surfaces are neutral charcoal with warm-grey text; regions are separated by 1px hairlines instead of shadows and use a tighter 6px radius. The primary is amber with near-black text (WCAG AA). Numbers in reports and badges use a system monospace stack with tabular figures so columns line up; body text keeps the theme font. Warning is a lighter yellow so it stays distinct from the amber primary. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Header, navigation, report and badge refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
